CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT ['building_number','building_name_long'] AS columns
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses_with_terms" AS SELECT ['subject_id','subject_title','term_code','academic_year','first_day_of_classes','meet_place'] AS columns

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT building_number, building_name_long
  FROM buildings
  WHERE building_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(building_number) <> ''
), base AS (
  SELECT 
    subject_title AS course_name,
    meet_place,
    term_code,
    academic_year,
    -- Parse several possible date formats; fallback to FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES if already date-like
    COALESCE(
      TRY_STRPTIME(first_day_of_classes, '%d-%b-%y'),
      TRY_STRPTIME(first_day_of_classes, '%d-%b-%Y'),
      TRY_STRPTIME(first_day_of_classes, '%Y-%m-%d')
    ) AS start_dt_raw,
    CASE 
      WHEN meet_place IS NULL OR TRIM(meet_place) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRIM(meet_place), '^(\w+)')
    END AS candidate_code
  FROM courses_with_terms
), with_bldg AS (
  SELECT b.*, bl.building_name_long AS building_name
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN bldg bl
    ON UPPER(b.candidate_code) = UPPER(bl.building_number)
), with_start AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(start_dt_raw, DATE '1900-01-01') AS start_dt
  FROM with_bldg
), ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    course_name,
    COALESCE(building_name, candidate_code) AS building_name,
    academic_year,
    start_dt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY academic_year ORDER BY start_dt, course_name) AS rn_in_year
  FROM with_start
), cumu AS (
  SELECT 
    course_name,
    building_name,
    academic_year,
    start_dt,
    rn_in_year,
    SUM(rn_in_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year, start_dt, course_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_courses_through_year
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
  course_name,
  building_name,
  academic_year,
  start_dt AS course_start_date,
  cumulative_courses_through_year AS cumulative_courses
FROM cumu
ORDER BY academic_year, course_start_date, course_name
LIMIT 100

extract_sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH off AS (
  SELECT 
    (columns->>'term_code') AS term_code,
    (columns->>'subject_title') AS course_name,
    COALESCE((columns->>'meet_place'), (columns->>'meet_location'), (columns->>'room')) AS meet_place
  FROM offerings
), trm AS (
  SELECT 
    (columns->>'term_code') AS term_code,
    (columns->>'first_day_of_classes') AS first_day_of_classes,
    CAST(columns->>'academic_year' AS BIGINT) AS academic_year
  FROM terms
), bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT (columns->>'building_number') AS building_number,
                  (columns->>'building_name_long') AS building_name_long
  FROM buildings_ref
  WHERE (columns->>'building_number') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(columns->>'building_number') <> ''
), joined AS (
  SELECT 
    o.course_name,
    o.meet_place,
    t.academic_year,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_STRPTIME(t.first_day_of_classes, '%d-%b-%y'),

      TRY_STRPTIME(t.first_day_of_classes, '%Y-%m-%d'),
      TRY_STRPTIME(t.first_day_of_classes, '%m/%d/%Y')
    ) AS start_dt,
    CASE 
      WHEN o.meet_place IS NULL OR TRIM(o.meet_place) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRIM(o.meet_place), '^(\\w+)')
    END AS candidate_code
  FROM off o
  LEFT JOIN trm t USING(term_code)
), with_bldg AS (
  SELECT 
    course_name,
    COALESCE(bl.building_name_long, candidate_code) AS building_name,
    academic_year,
    COALESCE(start_dt, DATE '1900-01-01') AS start_dt
  FROM joined j
  LEFT JOIN bldg bl
    ON UPPER(j.candidate_code) = UPPER(bl.building_number)

    course_name,
